contexts.text: Without this freedom, or spontaneousness, or voluntariness, man cannot be reformed.
Things which were spontaneous. Signified, Explained.
Whatever is from affection is spontaneous, most especially that which is from the ardour of affection.
The conjunction of truth and good in the Natural, is not effected except through what is spontaneous.
What is spontaneous, or free. Signified.
Temptation until they submitted themselves from what is spontaneous. Treated of.
Things which have become familiar... flow of their own accord.
Whatever (those in good) think and do, flows as it were spontaneous, and from freedom.
By continual use or habit, they become as if spontaneous and natural.
Whom his heart moves willingly () = from freedom.
The things of the heart and the cerebellum are called involuntary and spontaneous, because they so appear.
These are the things signified by those which the sons of Israel offered willingly.
All correspondence is natural and spontaneous.
The speech of the Angels flows immediately and spontaneously from their thought, and this from their affection...
When (love and innocence) are present, all things of faith are received as it were spontaneously.
Worship not compulsory, but spontaneous, does not shut evils in.
May the willing spirit uphold me ().
The willing ones of the people are gathered together (). AE 331:7.
The things written above... came spontaneously upon the paper.
In some it appears as if it were spontaneous, although it is of the Lord alone.
Thus the words flow spontaneous.
That sorceresses attach themselves to... the spontaneous things. SE 4518.
How spontaneous things draw towards Hell.
The Spontaneous, which is the Hereditary of man...
Spontaneous things are those which are of the general sense, and have their place in the occiput.
The willing ones of the people () = those in the goods of truth.
